reuse.why: The new action uses the existing getFillableCategories, getSheetValue and sheetForMonth through a fillMonth helper that the 3-, 6- and 12-month averages now share as well.

duplication.why: It removes the copied loops from set3MonthAvg and setFixedMonthAvg; setNMonthAvg still keeps its own expense sign flip next to fillMonth's.

placement.why: The action and helper sit in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Rewriting set3MonthAvg and setFixedMonthAvg onto fillMonth goes beyond adding the action, but it is the extraction the new action needs.

maintainability.why: A callback-based fillMonth keeps selection, income rule and sign in one place for all amount-based fills; the duplicate sign flip in setNMonthAvg is the remaining drift point.
